title: Sheraia
summary: Raleigh names Sheraia in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sheraia, to whom Ieremie gaue the Booke of the euill that should fall vpon Babylon, when he went with Zedechias. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVIII, §. VI, sig. 379a
